title: Daskam 31 — The Humbling of Bali
description: Vamana asks Bali for three steps of land; Bali gives without hesitation, and the Lord measures the worlds, binds him, and grants him a place in Sutala.

stanzas.sanskrit:
प्रीत्या दैत्यस्तव तनुमहःप्रेक्षणात् सर्वथाऽपि
त्वामाराध्यन्नजित रचयन्नञ्जलिं सञ्जगाद ।
मत्तः किं ते समभिलषितं विप्रसूनो वद त्वं
वित्तं भक्तं भवनमवनीं वाऽपि सर्वं प्रदास्ये ॥ ३१-१ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
prītyā daityastava tanumahaḥprekṣaṇāt sarvathā’pi
tvāmārādhyannajita racayannañjaliṁ sañjagāda |
mattaḥ kiṁ te samabhilaṣitaṁ viprasūno vada tvaṁ
vittaṁ bhaktaṁ bhavanamavanīṁ vā’pi sarvaṁ pradāsye || 31-1 ||
stanzas.translation_status: No sourced English translation was supplied or retrieved; intentionally left blank.
stanzas.commentary_en: Mahabali attracted by Bhagwan’s glorious majestic sight , did the welcoming rituals and offered him seat. He then requested Vamana with folded hands as to what he desires to have, wealth or house or food or land or all the above.

stanzas.sanskrit:
तामक्षीणां बलिगिरमुपाकर्ण्य कारुण्यपूर्णो-
ऽप्यस्योत्सेकं शमयितुमना दैत्यवंशं प्रशंसन् ।
भूमिं पादत्रयपरिमितां प्रार्थयामासिथ त्वं
सर्वं देहीति तु निगदिते कस्य हास्यं न वा स्यात् ॥ ३१-२ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tāmakṣīṇāṁ baligiramupākarṇya kāruṇyapūrṇo-
-‘pyasyotsekaṁ śamayitumanā daityavaṁśaṁ praśaṁsan |
bhūmiṁ pādatrayaparimitāṁ prārthayāmāsitha tvaṁ
sarvaṁ dehīti tu nigadite kasya hāsyaṁ na vā syāt || 31-2 ||
stanzas.translation_status: No sourced English translation was supplied or retrieved; intentionally left blank.
stanzas.commentary_en: Vamana, hearing Bali's words was moved with compassion, praised the asura clan with sweet words and with intention of removing his pride, asked for three steps of land, measured with his foot.

stanzas.sanskrit:
विश्वेशं मां त्रिपदमिह किं याचसे बालिशस्त्वं
सर्वां भूमिं वृणु किममुनेत्यालपत् त्वां स दृप्यन् ।
यस्माद्दर्पात् त्रिपदपरिपूर्त्यक्षमः क्षेपवादान्
बन्धं चासावगमदतदर्होऽपि गाढोपशान्त्यै ॥ ३१-३ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
viśveśaṁ māṁ tripadamiha kiṁ yācase bāliśastvaṁ
sarvāṁ bhūmiṁ vṛṇu kimamunetyālapat tvāṁ sa dṛpyan |
yasmāddarpāt tripadaparipūrtyakṣamaḥ kṣepavādān
bandhaṁ cāsāvagamadatadarho’pi gāḍhopaśāntyai || 31-3 ||
stanzas.translation_status: No sourced English translation was supplied or retrieved; intentionally left blank.
stanzas.commentary_en: Mahabali was taken aback by this and asked Vamana, why he is asking so less, when Mahabali who is conqueror of three worlds can even give him, the entire earth. Thus his pride got exposed.

stanzas.sanskrit:
पादत्रय्या यदि न मुदितो विष्टपैर्नापि तुष्ये-
-दित्युक्तेऽस्मिन् वरद भवते दातुकामेऽथ तोयम् ।
दैत्याचार्यस्तव खलु परीक्षार्थिनः प्रेरणात् तं
मा मा देयं हरिरयमिति व्यक्तमेवाबभाषे ॥ ३१-४ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
pādatrayyā yadi na mudito viṣṭapairnāpi tuṣye-
-dityukte’smin varada bhavate dātukāme’tha toyam |
daityācāryastava khalu parīkṣārthinaḥ preraṇāt taṁ
mā mā deyaṁ harirayamiti vyaktamevābabhāṣe || 31-4 ||
stanzas.translation_status: No sourced English translation was supplied or retrieved; intentionally left blank.
stanzas.commentary_en: Vamana replied that one who is not satisfied with three steps of land, will not be satisfied with anything more. Bali was about to pour water and confirm his giving, when Guru Sukracharya objected to the gifting and said that it is Bhagwan who has come in the Brahmin form.

stanzas.sanskrit:
याचत्येवं यदि स भगवान् पूर्णकामोऽस्मि सोऽहं
दास्याम्येव स्थिरमिति वदन् काव्यशप्तोऽपि दैत्यः ।
विन्ध्यावल्या निजदयितया दत्तपाद्याय तुभ्यं
चित्रं चित्रं सकलमपि स प्रार्पयत् तोयपूर्वम् ॥ ३१-५ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
yācatyevaṁ yadi sa bhagavān pūrṇakāmo’smi so’haṁ
dāsyāmyeva sthiramiti vadan kāvyaśapto’pi daityaḥ |
vindhyāvalyā nijadayitayā dattapādyāya tubhyaṁ
citraṁ citraṁ sakalamapi sa prārpayat toyapūrvam || 31-5 ||
stanzas.translation_status: No sourced English translation was supplied or retrieved; intentionally left blank.
stanzas.commentary_en: He told Shukracharya that if Bhagwan Himself has come, asking for land to Him, then he will definitely give. Shukracharya cursed Mahabali for refusing to listen to him. Mahabali's wife Vindhyaavali took the pot of water to pour and confirm the gift.

stanzas.sanskrit:
निस्सन्देहं दितिकुलपतौ त्वय्यशेषार्पणं त-
-द्व्यातन्वाने मुमुचुरृषयः सामराः पुष्पवर्षम् ।
दिव्यं रूपं तव च तदिदं पश्यतां विश्वभाजा-
-मुच्चैरुच्चैरवृधदवधीकृत्य विश्वाण्डभाण्डम् ॥ ३१-६ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
nissandehaṁ ditikulapatau tvayyaśeṣārpaṇaṁ ta-
-dvyātanvāne mumucurṛṣayaḥ sāmarāḥ puṣpavarṣam |
divyaṁ rūpaṁ tava ca tadidaṁ paśyatāṁ viśvabhājā-
-muccairuccairavṛdhadavadhīkṛtya viśvāṇḍabhāṇḍam || 31-6 ||
stanzas.translation_status: No sourced English translation was supplied or retrieved; intentionally left blank.
stanzas.commentary_en: Mahabali gave everything to Bhagwan as per his promise without any hesitation and doubt. As the water was poured, divine sages and Gods showered flowers on Bhagwan. Vamana immediately grew to a giant size spanning the entire cosmos.

stanzas.sanskrit:
त्वत्पादाग्रं निजपदगतं पुण्डरीकोद्भवोऽसौ
कुण्डीतोयैरसिचदपुनाद्यज्जलं विश्वलोकान् ।
हर्षोत्कर्षात् सुबहु ननृते खेचरैरुत्सवेऽस्मिन्
भेरीं निघ्नन् भुवनमचरज्जाम्बवान् भक्तिशाली ॥ ३१-७ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tvatpādāgraṁ nijapadagataṁ puṇḍarīkodbhavo’sau
kuṇḍītoyairasicadapunādyajjalaṁ viśvalokān |
harṣotkarṣāt subahu nanṛte khecarairutsave’smin
bherīṁ nighnan bhuvanamacarajjāmbavān bhaktiśālī || 31-7 ||
stanzas.translation_status: No sourced English translation was supplied or retrieved; intentionally left blank.
stanzas.commentary_en: Bhagwan’s  feet  touched satyalokham, Brahma's abode. Brahma washed Bhagwan's feet with water in his kamandalam, which then fell as Akaasha Ganga purifying the entire universe. Gandharvas danced in ecstasy and the great devotee of Bhagwan, the Jaambhavan went around the world beating his drum.

stanzas.sanskrit:
तावद्दैत्यास्त्वनुमतिमृते भर्तुरारब्धयुद्धा
देवोपेतैर्भवदनुचरैः सङ्गता भङ्गमापन् ।
कालात्माऽयं वसति पुरतो यद्वशात् प्राग्जिताः स्मः
किं वो युद्धैरिति बलिगिरा तेऽथ पातालमापुः ॥ ३१-८ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tāvaddaityāstvanumatimṛte bharturārabdhayuddhā
devopetairbhavadanucaraiḥ saṅgatā bhaṅgamāpan |
kālātmā’yaṁ vasati purato yadvaśāt prāgjitāḥ smaḥ
kiṁ vo yuddhairiti baligirā te’tha pātālamāpuḥ || 31-8 ||
stanzas.translation_status: No sourced English translation was supplied or retrieved; intentionally left blank.
stanzas.commentary_en: The Asuras started to fight with the Devas without Bali's permission. They were defeated by Bhagwan’s representatives who had come there and were fighting on the Deva's side. Bali told them that Bhagwan in the form of Trivikrama was standing before them by whose grace they had won earlier, and was now against them. So it was no use to fight. At this the Asuras went away to Paataala lokam.

stanzas.sanskrit:
पाशैर्बद्धं पतगपतिना दैत्यमुच्चैरवादी-
-स्तार्तीयीकं दिश मम पदं किं न विश्वेश्वरोऽसि ।
पादं मूर्ध्नि प्रणय भगवन्नित्यकम्पं वदन्तं
प्रह्लादस्तं स्वयमुपगतो मानयन्नस्तवीत्त्वाम् ॥ ३१-९ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
pāśairbaddhaṁ patagapatinā daityamuccairavādī-
-stārtīyīkaṁ diśa mama padaṁ kiṁ na viśveśvaro’si |
pādaṁ mūrdhni praṇaya bhagavannityakampaṁ vadantaṁ
prahlādastaṁ svayamupagato mānayanastavīttvām || 31-9 ||
stanzas.translation_status: No sourced English translation was supplied or retrieved; intentionally left blank.
stanzas.commentary_en: Garuda tied Bali with ropes and brought him before Bhagwan. Bhagwan questioned Bali where he can keep his third step. Bali with all humility, requested Bhagwan to keep the foot on his head to measure the third step. Grandfather Prahalad came to Bali's side and praised him with hymns at his humble act.

stanzas.sanskrit:
दर्पोच्छित्त्यै विहितमखिलं दैत्य सिद्धोऽसि पुण्यै-
-र्लोकस्तेऽस्तु त्रिदिवविजयी वासवत्वं च पश्चात् ।
मत्सायुज्यं भज च पुनरित्यन्वगृह्णा बलिं तं
विप्रैः सन्तानितमखवरः पाहि वातालयेश ॥ ३१-१० ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
darpocchittyai vihitamakhilaṁ daitya siddho’si puṇyai-
-rlokaste’stu tridivavijayī vāsavatvaṁ ca paścāt |
matsāyujyaṁ bhaja ca punarityanvagṛhṇā baliṁ taṁ
vipraiḥ santānitamakhavaraḥ pāhi vātālayeśa || 31-10 ||
stanzas.translation_status: No sourced English translation was supplied or retrieved; intentionally left blank.
stanzas.commentary_en: Bhagwan happy with Mahabali, told him that all this was done only to destroy his pride. He will get to rule Suutalam world which is more superior than even Indraloka. He would attain the position of Indra also. With the help of Brahmins, Bhagwan helped the Vishavajit yagnya of Mahabali to get completed.
